data.body: Claimed seaisland-nonliteral-tigermoth after refreshing the stale parent plan certificate. Worktree comment-remediation-82bc is based on origin/main da355b1c7ed7. Scope is comments, docstrings, and blank lines only in the six declared scripts/_mechanism_delta paths. No behavioral TDD tests are authored because executable behavior must remain AST-identical. Validate strict block shortening, normalized non-docstring AST equality, exact directives and shebangs, scoped Ruff and format, full-tree comment hygiene, scoped diff integrity, and the focused mechanism-delta suite. Per operator instruction, defer make verify to Gerrit CI. Landing uses the independent per-change Gerrit flow because feature-branch-driver rights are not assumed.
